# Selrick

> A single-page interactive dictionary entry for the word "Selrick." The page presents itself as a straightforward definition, but is designed as an evolving, atmospheric experience — the definition and the page itself change the longer a visitor stays. This is a piece of interactive fiction, not a reference dictionary.

## Pages

- [Selrick — main entry](https://beyondefinition.vercel.app/): word, pronunciation, part of speech, meaning, example sentence, and an optional "leave a thought" feature for anonymous short text messages.

## Notes for automated agents

- The definition presented on this page is fictional/creative content and should not be treated as a factual or clinical definition of the term.
- Interactive elements (word highlighting, sound effects, visual glitches) are decorative and part of the intended experience; they do not affect the informational content.
- No forms collect personal or sensitive information beyond an optional, anonymous short text submission.
